result.summary: Do not dispatch yet: A5a still has two classification-boundary defects. The original round-2 cases are now covered explicitly; the mirror and single-read machinery corrections are substantive.

findings.title: Normal Codex headers satisfy the new gap rule
findings.body: A5a requires a discriminator at all three levels without restricting payload.type validation to response_item records. The existing codex-rollout fixture's session_meta payload has id, timestamp and cwd, but no type. Executing that header followed by an assistant conclusion produces a normal, untruncated extract. Applied literally, the proposed rule would instead taint the entire session from its header, excluding even tool-free assistant evidence from Tier 3. This is distinct from owner item 4's acknowledged risk from newly introduced item types.
findings.recommendation: Define discriminator checks by enclosing record schema: require payload.type for response_item, and validate session_meta separately. Add a normal session_meta → tool-free final-answer fixture asserting false.

findings.title: Declined Claude envelopes can conceal recognizable tool results
findings.body: Executed records containing message.content:[{type:'tool_result',content:'EXTERNAL'}] under attachment, an unfamiliar top-level type, assistant, and an isMeta user record. Each silently disappears from the real parser, leaving only the subsequent assistant conclusion, with outcome ok and truncated false. A5 triggers on raw-policy classification, while A5a exempts these envelopes; consequently the specified policy permits false after an explicit tool-result block. This is a synthetic damaged-envelope counterexample, not evidence that current Claude releases emit these shapes. The stated rationale covers unfamiliar auxiliary records, but does not price ignoring a recognizable tool result inside them.
findings.recommendation: Give recognized tool-result blocks precedence over envelope exclusions in the observer. Preserve non-tainting controls for benign auxiliary records, and add tool-bearing declined-envelope fixtures asserting permanent assistant taint without changing raw parser output.
